question: What is the chemical basis for the reversible inhibition of acetylcholinesterase by the alkaloid physostigmine and related compounds ?:

options.opb: Covalent binding to a cofactor essential for the reaction.
options.opc: Coordination of an Mg2 + cation in the active center of the enzyme.
options.opd: Analogy with the transition state of the reaction catalyzed by the enzyme.
options.ope: Formation of a carbamate (carbamoylation) of the serine residue in the active center of the enzyme.
